notes: All samples are E. coli infected with T7 (wild type, codon-recoded gene 10, evolved recoded), 1/5/9 min post-infection; no uninfected sample, so is_control left out. Host strain, medium, temperature and growth phase not given. mixed_organism set true because libraries contain T7 phage RNA alongside host RNA (uncertain whether phage counts as a second organism). Host genotype is unchanged across samples (reference); T7 genotype differences are not host perturbations.
